dispatched_notes: 95-01 (95th BG Memorials Foundation database, mission 10/14/1943): took off 18, completed 16, damaged 5, lost 1, salvaged 0; 2 aborts (Kring 42-3465, R.M. Smith 42-30167). Lost = 42-30135 (MACR 855). 42-3462 returned but 3 gunners bailed out and became POW (MACR 856). Four 100th BG crews in 100th BG aircraft also flew in the 95th's formation (100th report: 'high group with 95th'); they are recorded in 100th.json, not counted here.
